name: bng-metric-harness
description: Meta-repo that orchestrates bng-metric-frontend and bng-metric-backend

scripts.lib:status: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='node_modules/bng-library';try{const s=fs.lstatSync(p);console.log('bng-library: '+(s.isSymbolicLink()?('LINKED -> '+fs.realpathSync(p)):'installed from pin (not linked)'))}catch{console.log('bng-library: not installed')}"
scripts.likec4:export: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/data" -w /data likec4/likec4 export png -o ./arch-diagrams likec4
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:aggregate && npm run docs:likec4 && mkdocs build
scripts.docs:serve: npm run docs:aggregate && npm run docs:likec4 && mkdocs serve
scripts.docs:serve:docker: npm run docs:aggregate && docker run --rm -it -p 8000:8000 -v "$PWD:/docs" -w /docs squidfunk/mkdocs-material:9 serve --dev-addr 0.0.0.0:8000
scripts.docs:build:docker: npm run docs:aggregate && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/docs" -w /docs squidfunk/mkdocs-material:9 build
scripts.setup:husky: node -e "try { (await import('husky')).default() } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }" --input-type module
